fields.title: 8. Three Data Points to Check Directly Before the Next Issue
fields.md:
1. **Flight 15 Ship 42 return result** (around 11/15 06:20 KST) is judged using the definition in Section 2. The basis is the LL2 Ship landing success field and either the official SpaceX flight summary or two top-tier news reports. Also check the company's official record of the reason for the booster abort and any FAA mishap investigation designation (Source: [LL2](https://ll.thespacedevs.com/2.3.0/launches/0f867f0c-5422-4d44-93b8-d7faaae7019b/)).
2. Check the **original complaint text and case number of the 11/12 SF Superior Court filing** (T16). Because the 9/18 lawsuit was not in the 10-Q, the legal proceedings note in the 4Q26 10-K is the next disclosure checkpoint (Source: [10-Q R25](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1181412/000162828026066880/R25.htm)).
3. **Existing checkpoints**: T7 ⓒ 11/18 · T2 12/8 lock-up · T12 12/9 vote · Tesla merger 8-K (T6) · monthly 12/01 (Source: `state.triggers_next_12m`).
